name: Percipio Viewer
summary: Desktop viewer for connecting Percipio depth cameras, previewing RGB/depth/point-cloud data, configuring acquisition and applying depth post-processing. Windows and Ubuntu packages are offered separately from the SDK; a legacy viewer remains documented for older camera compatibility.

description.en: Desktop viewer for connecting Percipio depth cameras, previewing RGB/depth/point-cloud data, configuring acquisition and applying depth post-processing. Windows and Ubuntu packages are offered separately from the SDK; a legacy viewer remains documented for older camera compatibility.
